extension.description: Review staged Git changes from VS Code Source Control using the local Codex CLI with fail-safe diagnostics.
command.review.title: Review Staged Changes
command.clear.title: Clear Review Results
command.showOutput.title: Show Review Report
command.checkEnvironment.title: Check Codex Environment
capability.untrusted: Codex Review Safe executes Git and the local Codex CLI and reads staged workspace content, so a trusted workspace is required.
capability.virtual: Codex Review Safe requires a local Git repository and local CLI executables.
config.codexPath: Codex CLI executable path. Application-scoped: only User Settings can configure it.
config.model: Optional Codex model. Application-scoped: only User Settings can configure it.
config.language: Language used for review summary and findings.
config.maxDiffBytes: Per-review evidence chunk budget in bytes. Changed hunks that cannot fit are explicit fail-closed coverage gaps.
config.maxFindings: Maximum number of review findings accepted from Codex.
config.severityThreshold: Minimum severity shown in Problems and the review report.
config.confidenceThreshold: Minimum confidence required for a finding to affect Problems diagnostics and the review verdict.
config.timeoutSeconds: Maximum time to wait for Codex CLI.
config.extraInstructions: Additional user-level review instructions. They cannot override the extension safety boundary.
command.importSarif.title: Import SARIF Evidence
command.generateFix.title: Generate Safe Fix Proposal
config.profile: Review execution profile; adjusts evidence depth only within existing safety and budget caps.
config.sarifFiles: Repository-relative SARIF files pre-generated by the user or CI; the extension never executes analyzer commands.
command.forceReview.title: Force Re-review Staged Changes
command.resolveFinding.title: Resolve Review Finding
command.clearResolutions.title: Clear Finding Resolutions
